name: Selpercatinib (RET fusion-positive NSCLC)
supportiveCare: Continuous oral dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
Weight-based: 160 mg BID if >= 50 kg, 120 mg BID if < 50 kg.
Monitor for hypertension, transaminase elevation, and QTc prolongation.

drugs.name: Selpercatinib
drugs.notes: Selpercatinib 160 mg PO twice daily (patients >= 50 kg; 120 mg BID if < 50 kg), continuous, for RET fusion-positive disease. Pralsetinib 400 mg PO once daily is an accepted alternative RET inhibitor. Dose shown is the >= 50 kg flat dose. My own wording.

provenance.locator: RET fusion-positive NSCLC (selpercatinib 160 mg BID, >= 50 kg)
